journeys.description: Ingest resources and prove dedicated inheritance or shared explicit resolution.
Assign predefined and custom roles to users, groups, clients, and service accounts.
Verify Effective Access source, tenant lineage, expiry, and mapping version.
Exercise list, count, detail, mutation, batch, job, task, incident, history, and deployment paths with filtered and denied results.
Revoke assignments and remove mappings during an active browser and API session.
Transition dedicated to shared and shared to dedicated with preview, acknowledgement, concurrency conflict, apply, cache invalidation, and rollback.
Rotate engine credentials without changing tenant ownership.
Decommission an engine and prove assignments, mappings, inventory, and cached access cannot resurrect it.
